title: Minimality against adding an integer multiplicity cycle supported in A ∩ W (step 5 of the parent)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, A ⊆ ℝ^P, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in A (contract IsMinimizingIn T A: T is integer multiplicity and M_{W′}(T) ≤ M_{W′}(S) for every open W′ ⊂⊂ U and every integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with ∂S = ∂T and spt(S − T) a compact subset of A ∩ W′). Let W ⊆ ℝ^P be open with W ⊂⊂ U (contract CompactlyContained W U: closure(W) is compact and contained in U). Let X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) be integer multiplicity with ∂X = 0, spt X compact and spt X ⊆ A ∩ W, and let Z₁ ∈ 𝒟_n(U) satisfy Z₁(ω) = T(ω) + X(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U), where X is evaluated at ω regarded as a test form on ℝ^P (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U)). Then M_W(T) ≤ M_W(Z₁) (SimonGMT massOn).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U A W : Set (Euclid P)) (T Z₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T A → IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.boundary = 0 → IsCompact X.support → X.support ⊆ A ∩ W → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), Z₁ ω = T ω + X (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) (m + 1) ω)) → T.massOn W ≤ Z₁.massOn W
